mailbox.heading: [XX-Mailbox-XX]
mailbox.description: [XX-Order confirmations are read from a dedicated mailbox over IMAP. Monize only reads it: it never changes, moves or deletes a message.-XX]
mailbox.dedicatedWarning: [XX-Use a dedicated mailbox. Every message in the folder is read, so it should hold nothing but order confirmations.-XX]
mailbox.encryptionUnavailable: [XX-This server cannot encrypt secrets, so a mailbox password or connection cannot be saved. Ask the administrator to set up encryption.-XX]

error.title: [XX-The mailbox could not be loaded-XX]
error.body: [XX-The request failed, so nothing is known about your mailbox yet. Try again.-XX]

oauth.heading: [XX-Connect an account-XX]
oauth.explanation: [XX-Google and Microsoft 365 usually refuse a plain password. Sign in with the provider instead: you grant Monize access to the mailbox and never type its password here.-XX]
oauth.providersUnavailable: [XX-Whether Google or Microsoft sign-in is available could not be checked. The manual form below still works.-XX]
oauth.badAuthorizationUrl: [XX-The server returned a sign-in address that is not a secure web page, so it was not opened.-XX]
oauth.notConnected: [XX-The connection to {provider} is not active, so the mailbox is not being read. Connect again to resume.-XX]

disconnectDialog.title: [XX-Disconnect the mailbox?-XX]
disconnectDialog.message: [XX-Monize will delete its stored access to {provider} and stop reading the mailbox. Emails already stored are kept.-XX]

oauth.revokeNote: [XX-Disconnecting does not remove the permission you granted. To withdraw it, remove Monize on the {provider} permissions page.-XX]

form.intro: [XX-Or enter the details of any IMAP mailbox. Most providers need an app password rather than your account password.-XX]
form.passwordStoredPlaceholder: [XX-A password is stored. Type to replace it.-XX]
form.passwordRequiredHelp: [XX-Required for a new mailbox, or when the server or user name changes.-XX]
form.passwordKeepHelp: [XX-Leave blank to keep the stored password. It is never shown again.-XX]

test.ok: [XX-{count, plural, one {The connection works. The folder holds # message.} other {The connection works. The folder holds # messages.}}-XX]

settings.folderHelp: [XX-The folder to read. It is opened read-only.-XX]
settings.enabledHelp: [XX-When on, the mailbox is polled every 15 minutes. You can always use Poll now.-XX]
settings.aiModeHelp: [XX-Whether the AI provider you configured may be used on receipts. An AI answer is always a proposal or a draft that you approve.-XX]

aiModeDescriptions.off: [XX-The AI is never called for receipts.-XX]
aiModeDescriptions.on_demand: [XX-The AI is called only when you press Recognize with AI or Draft parser with AI.-XX]
aiModeDescriptions.automatic: [XX-The poll asks the AI about a matched receipt that no approved parser could read completely, and drafts a parser for a sender that has none.-XX]

settings.autoApplyHelp: [XX-Off by default. A proposal is applied without asking only when all of these hold: an approved parser read the whole email, the transaction was found by order number or by exact amount and payee with a single candidate, and the proposal adds up to the cent. Everything else waits for your approval.-XX]

status.pollResult: [XX-Poll finished: {fetched, plural, one {# email stored} other {# emails stored}}, {skipped} skipped, {processed} processed.-XX]

deleteDialog.title: [XX-Delete the mailbox?-XX]
deleteDialog.message: [XX-The mailbox settings and every stored email will be deleted, and open review requests from them dismissed. The emails in the mailbox itself are not touched.-XX]

parsers.heading: [XX-Parsers-XX]
parsers.description: [XX-A parser reads the order confirmations of one sender with patterns you write or review. Once approved it runs without the AI.-XX]

empty.title: [XX-No parsers yet-XX]
empty.body: [XX-Create one for a sender of order confirmations, or draft one from a stored email on the Email Receipts page.-XX]

toasts.changedElsewhere: [XX-This parser was changed elsewhere. The list has been reloaded.-XX]

deleteDialog.title: [XX-Delete the parser?-XX]
deleteDialog.message: [XX-The parser {name} will be deleted. Emails it already read keep their results.-XX]

lookupsError.title: [XX-Payees and categories could not be loaded-XX]
lookupsError.body: [XX-The pickers need them, so the editor cannot open yet. Try again.-XX]

editor.draftNote: [XX-This parser is a draft. It reads nothing until you approve it.-XX]
editor.draftAiNote: [XX-The AI drafted this parser from one sample email. Check every pattern against your emails, then approve it from the list. It reads nothing until you do.-XX]
editor.domainsHelp: [XX-One per line, up to {max}. A sub-domain of a listed domain also matches.-XX]
editor.subjectHelp: [XX-Optional, one per line, up to {max}. The subject must contain at least one of them, ignoring case.-XX]
editor.conflict: [XX-This parser was changed elsewhere since you opened it. Reload it to see the current version. Your edits here are not saved.-XX]

patterns.globHelp: [XX-Each pattern is matched against one whole line of the email, ignoring case. Use {star} for any text and a name in braces, such as {capture}, to capture a value. Each field takes up to {max} patterns, one per line.-XX]
patterns.startAfterHint: [XX-Optional. Items are read from the line after the first line containing this text.-XX]
patterns.stopAtHint: [XX-Optional. Items end before the first line containing this text.-XX]
patterns.itemPatternsHint: [XX-Must capture {name} and either {amount} (the line total) or {price} (the unit price, optionally with {qty}), never both. Example: {name} x {qty} {price}-XX]

categories.rulesHelp: [XX-The first rule whose pattern matches an item name sets its category. Patterns use the same syntax, for example {example}. Up to {max} rules.-XX]
categories.noRules: [XX-No category rules. Every item gets the default category.-XX]
categories.defaultHelp: [XX-Used for items that no rule matches.-XX]

codes.unknown_key: [XX-is not something a parser can have-XX]
codes.invalid_version: [XX-is a version this server does not read-XX]
codes.malformed_capture: [XX-has a capture in braces that is not valid-XX]
codes.capture_not_allowed: [XX-uses a capture name this field does not accept-XX]
codes.capture_missing: [XX-is missing a capture this field needs-XX]
codes.capture_conflict: [XX-captures both the line total and the unit price. Use one of them.-XX]

test.heading: [XX-Test against a stored email-XX]
test.help: [XX-Reads a stored email with the patterns above, saved or not, and shows what would be found and which transaction it would match. Nothing is written.-XX]

test.ambiguous: [XX-{count, plural, one {# transaction fits} other {# transactions fit}} equally well, so none would be linked until you choose.-XX]
test.unmatched: [XX-No transaction matches, out of {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}}.-XX]
